answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation: an agent locks collateral to earn voting power, and that power tracks stake size, not the number of accounts. A rival splitting a ferrous pile of capital across a thousand wallets gains nothing, since each wallet needs its own bond and the votes still sum to the same stake. Caught fraud slashes the locked funds, so attacking burns real capital instead of minting cheap ivory identities. To forge a majority, the adversary must out-stake honest agents, not out-number them.
